name: Medtronic
outlook:
What Medtronic says to expect

  • Fiscal 2027: organic revenue growthThe company raised its FY27 organic revenue growth guidance to 7.25% to 7.75%, an increase from the prior guidance of 6.75% to 7.25%.
  • Fiscal 2027: non-GAAP earnings per shareThe company also raised its FY27 diluted non-GAAP EPS guidance to the new range of $5.94 to $6.00 versus the prior $5.90 to $6.00.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed September 1, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
